value.rationale: This solves a natural sharp holomorphic approximation question for the first quadratic anti-holomorphic monomial across every radial power weight. It reveals an unbounded sequence of optimal-degree phase transitions, exact algebraic transition values and complete equality families, information not supplied by mere boundedness/Schatten tests or large-index asymptotics. The result is a complete invariant of a canonical function-space problem rather than a decorative finite check.
